subject: Re: Observability add-ons — proposal for SKU restructure and variable discount path
messages:
From: Lina Morales <lina@acadiahealth.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Observability add-ons — retention and dashboards questions

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our infra and security teams reviewed the observability add-ons and had a few follow-ups before procurement can move forward:

- We need a clearer SKU that separates long-term retention (90/365/730 days) from short-term tracing (7/30 days) so we can map to our budgeting buckets.
- For advanced dashboards: we prefer a "seatless" entitlement (per-application visual bundles) rather than per-seat pricing — that aligns with our service teams.
- Any standard discount schedule for multi-year commitments or combined retention+tracing bundles?

Can you share a sample pricing table and a draft SOW that lists retention tiers and expected monthly billing for a 12-month vs 24-month commitment?

Tom Reeves from procurement is cc'd — he will own contract questions.

Appreciate it,

Lina Morales
Director, Platform Engineering
Acadia Health

Attachment: none
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
To: Lina Morales <lina@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: Tom Reeves <tom@acadiahealth.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — retention and dashboards questions

Lina — thanks, great questions. I pulled together a concise proposal and attached a sample SKU table + an initial SOW draft to give your procurement and security teams something concrete to review. High level:

1) SKU restructure (proposal)
   - Retention tiers: 90d / 365d / 730d with per-GB-month and a predictable slab for cold ingest (archive).
   - Tracing tiers: 7d (default), 30d (mid), 90d (extended) with an option to enable sampling policies for cost control.
   - Visuals: "Application Bundle" (seatless) and "Org Dashboards" (site license) — both are entitlement types rather than per-user seats.

2) Discount / credit path
   - 12-month commit: standard 12% discount on add-ons (stacked with hosted API credits).
   - 24-month commit: 20% discount + one-time onboarding credit (applied to first invoice).
   - Alternate: usage-credits model — prepay X TB-months for a deeper 25% discount and rollover for 3 months.

3) Example costs (attached pricing-model CSV): shows per-GB-month math and two sample customer invoices for 12/24 month scenarios.

Next steps I recommend: your procurement picks a preferred discount path (time commit vs prepaid credits) and we surface any regulatory/audit items for our SOC2/KMS note in the SOW. If you want, we can schedule a 30-min call Thursday to walk the SOW line-by-line.

I've attached: 20261110-retention-sku-table.xlsx, SOW-Acadia-visuals-draft.pdf, pricing-model-ACD-2026.csv

Cheers,

Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
phone: (415) 555-0198

Attachment stubs: 20261110-retention-sku-table.xlsx (sheet: tiered-pricing), SOW-Acadia-visuals-draft.pdf (6 pages), pricing-model-ACD-2026.csv
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 14:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — discount framing and margin check

Sean / team — quick internal note before the call with Acadia:

- Margin checks: the prepaid credits option needs careful packaging so we don't underprice cold storage. Propose we define a floor price for archived TBs and a separate cold ingress surcharge.
- Discount approval: front-line quota allows up to 15% on 12-months; anything >15% needs Sales Ops approval (we should propose 20% for 24-month commit with a measurable onboarding credit but mark it as conditional).
- Bundling rules: allow stacking of base API commit discounts with add-on discounts but cap total discount at 30% to preserve economics.

Irene, Jordan — please have the SLA/rollforward language ready (especially around data egress and snapshot exports) for tomorrow's call.

Kimberly Park
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachment: internal margin worksheet (not shared)
From: Tom Reeves <tom@acadiahealth.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: Lina Morales <lina@acadiahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — procurement follow-ups

Sean — thanks for the clear draft. A few procurement-specific asks:

- Invoice cadence: can you support monthly invoicing with a single consolidated line for all add-ons (we'd like to avoid per-sku multiple lines)?
- Tax and billing entity: Acadia needs a single legal entity on the invoice and a separate PO flow for onboarding credits — can you surface standard language you use for credits and one-time onboarding discounts?
- DocuSign: once the SOW is finalized, we'll need a DocuSign-ready SOW and a separate addendum listing the exact retention tiers.

Also, Lina asked if the seatless "Application Bundle" supports role-based access in the console (so only app owners can edit dashboards). Security wants the RBAC detail called out in the SOW.

If you can reply with a consolidated answer to cadence/tax/credits and an updated SOW with RBAC language, procurement can move to signature review next week.

Thanks,
Tom Reeves
Sr. Procurement Manager
Acadia Health

Attachment: PO template request (PDF referenced)
From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
To: Tom Reeves <tom@acadiahealth.com>, Lina Morales <lina@acadiahealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — proposal for SKU restructure and variable discount path (updated)

Tom / Lina — summary and confirmed next steps:

1) Billing cadence: we can do consolidated monthly invoicing. We'll produce a single add-ons line with a supporting breakdown CSV (for your internal chargeback) attached to the invoice.
2) Tax / billing entity: we will issue invoices to the legal entity on file; onboarding credits appear as a one-line credit on month-1 invoice. I'll have Finance produce the exact credit language used for PO intake.
3) DocuSign & SOW: updated SOW draft (SOW-Acadia-visuals-draft.pdf) will be revised to include RBAC details for seatless Application Bundles and explicit data egress/export SLAs. Expect revision by EOD Friday.
4) Discounts: recommend two options for Acadia to pick:
   a) 12-month term @ 12% add-on discount + standard onboarding credit
   b) 24-month term @ 20% add-on discount + onboarding credit and one-time professional services credit (conditional on compliance checklist)
   c) Prepay credits: 6- or 12-month prepaid TB-months for a 25% discount and 3-month rollover window
5) Sign-off path: if you pick option (a) or (b) we will prepare a DocuSign-ready SOW and an addendum listing the exact retention tiers and sample invoice line.

Would you prefer a quick 20-min sync tomorrow to pick the option, or shall we iterate on the SOW and circle back asynchronously?

Thanks — looking forward to finalizing this quickly.

Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com
phone: (415) 555-0198

Attachment stubs: revised SOW (pending), consolidated invoice example (to be attached), DocuSign link template will be provided when SOW is finalized.
